scope: development-only fixed-24-group calibration and fixed-24-group candidate-specific evaluation of v5.1 group-level conformal risk transport

cohort.partition_rule: sort SHA256('ersrr-v6-risk-calibration|' + group_id); first 24 groups calibrate and remaining 24 groups evaluate

calibration.method: most-permissive threshold satisfying (n * empirical group-balanced negative-crop FPR + 1) / (n + 1) <= alpha
calibration.pooled_comparator: most-permissive threshold with calibration negative-crop FPR <= target
calibration.selection_rule: primary alpha 0.075 is fixed; secondary alphas are descriptive and cannot replace it after evaluation

promotion_gates.pass_action: Retain the frozen group-CRC layer as a development candidate for a genuinely new sealed mixed cohort; do not evaluate the already-opened MethaneS2CM location test.
promotion_gates.failure_action: Reject group-CRC transport as operationally useful under this fixed split; do not search secondary alpha values on evaluation outcomes.

sequence: Verify implementation, dependency, input, partition, and score-cache bindings without opening outcome arrays.
Authorize calibration fit; use labels only from the fixed first 24 groups and write an ignored threshold artifact.
Hash-bind the fitted artifact and change status to evaluation_authorized_after_calibrator_freeze.
Join scores to labels once on the fixed remaining 24 groups and apply every promotion gate.
Do not use the opened location-test predictions or outcomes at any stage.

evidence_boundary.classification: candidate-specific development evidence, not untouched external confirmation
evidence_boundary.known_before_freeze: The prerequisite alignment audit exposed evaluation label marginals (3246 positive, 3182 negative) but did not inspect score-label association or candidate metrics.
evidence_boundary.prior_access: The underlying v5.1 development score family and labels were opened in earlier model-development work.

invariants: The model, score ordering, dense masks, and empirical-CDF score definition are frozen and unchanged.
Fit mode uses only the 24 calibration groups and refuses confirmation evaluation.
Evaluation mode requires a hash-bound fitted artifact and refuses overwrite.
The primary alpha, pooled comparator, bootstrap, and promotion gates cannot change after evaluation.
Secondary alpha results cannot be promoted after the primary evaluation fails.
Bulk caches and fitted threshold artifacts remain Git-ignored.
